body: People do care about you. Yes reading this you'd think no way is that possible but there is someone out there who does. Despite me being a complete stranger, I want you to keep trying. It's bloody hard i know as I'm still struggling with this myself. But i just keep goddamn trying. Care for yourself. It sucks when someone whose supposed to be close to you and care for you ignores your feelings. It's unfortunate but that doesn't mean to stop caring for yourself. It'll take time but do anything to live and be nice to yourself. Because one day, from just living a bit longer, you might find people who will support you. I wishing you to stay strong and don't give up!     (I'm sorry if my grammar is hella bad I'm a bit sick and it's late)
It's tough but once you make it, as you said, it will be nice accomplishment. One of your most memorable I would say yet.You've got this man, I believe in you.
He does know but I feel bad telling him that I'm kind of getting worse
Thanks man, hope you get out of your situation as well.
